name: TELEDYNE TECHNOLOGIES INC

overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 28, 2025 (filed 2026-02-20, accession 0001094285-26-000017), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows: 'Stock-based compensation' $39.6 million for FY2025, $37.7 million for FY2024 and $32.3 million for FY2023. EDGAR companyfacts carries the same expense only as quarterly/segment AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense facts (9M 2025 $30.7M in the Q3 2025 10-Q cash-flow statement matches), with no annual-duration fact under the engine's SBC tags, so the engine found no FY SBC for 2023-2025.
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:sbc - SBC missing for fiscal years 2023, 2024, 2025 of the last 3 under the engine's tags. The filer's own reported FY2025 stock-based compensation from its 10-K cash-flow statement fills the gap; the engine applies this single value to every missing period. The true per-year series in the same statement is $32.3M (FY2023) / $37.7M (FY2024) / $39.6M (FY2025), so applying $39.6M to all three years overstates SBC in the two earlier years and makes the 3-yr median base slightly conservative (median year FY2024 true SBC $37.7M vs $39.6M applied, ~$0.04/share).

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight

EDGAR companyfacts carries the same expense only as quarterly/segment AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense facts (9M 2025 $30.7M in the Q3 2025 10-Q cash-flow statement matches), with no annual-duration fact under the engine's SBC tags, so the engine found no FY SBC for 2023-2025.); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact

override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output
